description.value:
Your tactical acumen sharpens, boosting your Combat Superiority.

Improved Maneuvers. You start out knowing four maneuvers rather than two, and gain further maneuvers as you level up, per the Maneuvers Known column of the Tactical Superiority table.

Improved Superiority Dice. Your pool starts at four superiority dice instead of two, growing at higher levels per the Superiority Dice Quantity column of the same table.
